articles.title: Bitget set to exit Japan, close all remaining positions by year-end
articles.snippet: The crypto trading platform, ranked fifth on CoinGecko, stopped accepting new registrations on Sunday and plans to shut down all remaining positions by Dec. 31.

articles.title: AI Music Company Suno Loses Copyright Case in Germany
articles.snippet: The decision requires AI companies to license copyrighted music used to train models and generate songs, marking another legal win for music rights holders in Europe.
